Nina Gomez: Quick sync idea: a compact "mini-lab" launch — tutorial + tiny refapp + 20-min live benchmark demo. Goal: dev signups + repo stars.
Oliver Reed: 👍 timeline?
Nina Gomez: Target webinar Apr 18. Publish tutorial Apr 12, open repo Apr 14, promo starts Apr 8.
Priya Das: I'll write the tutorial (hands-on). Keep it <800 words with step commands and a short bench snippet.
Rohan Patel: I'll build a minimal bench script (30 requests, seq=256) and a fallback pre-record. Example to include:
```
python bench.py --model community-small --seq 256 --requests 30
```
Keep warmup=5.
Design Bot: asset request: hero image + 15s GIF of refapp streaming. Need assets by Apr 11.
Priya Das: CTA = RSVP (collect email, role, region). Post-event CTA points to repo + free trial coupon. Add hidden `interest` (Hosted/Dedicated/Private).
Oliver Reed: Lead routing: RSVP -> #marketing-leads + HubSpot. Add `priority` field (eval/pilot). Ops will confirm webhook.
Rohan Patel: Backup plan: have pre-recorded bench and use quantized `community-small-quant` if Dedicated pool noisy.
Nina Gomez: Messaging angle: "Run the same benchmark we use — reproducible, fast." Short social: "See p50/p95 and cost live. RSVP now."
Priya Das: I'll drop tutorial draft Apr 9 for review. Oliver/Rohan: can you review by Apr 10?
Oliver Reed: Yep.
